gloss: A few small nodules in the bed where the tumour lay. Recurrent pleomorphic adenoma is typically multinodular; this cluster is drawn as an outline to show the idea, not to predict where one would grow.
role: When a pleomorphic adenoma comes back, the most important cause named in one review is an operation that cut into the tumour and left some behind; a thin or incomplete capsule, finger-like extensions and satellite nodules make that more likely.
matters: When a pleomorphic adenoma comes back it is harder to treat, and a second recurrence is not rare. Radiotherapy after the repeat operation is linked with fewer further recurrences.
